import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_34/training_0.csv"
]

# Load all source tables into a list of DataFrames
source_dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)  # ignore the first numerical index column
    source_dfs.append(df)

# Since there is only one source table with schema ['J_CALL'] and target schema is ['V_GENE'],
# and the target examples show that V_GENE corresponds exactly to J_CALL values,
# the transformation is a simple rename of the column from 'J_CALL' to 'V_GENE'.

# Concatenate all source tables vertically (union) if there were multiple,
# here only one source table, so just take it directly.
combined_df = pd.concat(source_dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Rename the column to match the target schema
combined_df = combined_df.rename(columns={"J_CALL": "V_GENE"})

# Select only the target columns (in case source has extra columns)
target_df = combined_df[["V_GENE"]]

# Write the result to the target path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_34/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
